offer.text: The drowned hoard metal down in the dark water — and the odd trident, too. Send five of them back to the deep and salvage what they're hiding.

accept.text: Mind their tridents. They throw harder than you'd think.

decline.text: Then the river keeps its secrets a while longer.

in_progress.text: How many drowned have you cleared from the shallows?

ready.text: Five of the river-dead put to rest. Good diving.

complete.text: Whatever you hauled up, you earned. The forge thanks you.
